_: THE SIX STATS A HULL DID NOT HAVE — DESIGN_V1 §1.2's ten, minus the four the game already carried.
_already: hold, speed_kn, draft and durability are columns on public.ship_classes since 0002 and are not touched here.
_s7: Since 0129 every class carries ALL of its ship_classes columns here (name … build_cost, the six stats, note = stat_note) and scripts/db/world-guard.mjs holds the table, its slots, cabins and level unlocks EQUAL to this file.
_guns: `guns` stops being a stat and becomes what it always was: how many WEAPON fittings a hull can mount. §1.2 — 'that retires a dead column into a real one'.
_why_zero: A barca carries no guns, so her attack, accuracy and reach are 0 and stay 0 until something is mounted. A stat that is honestly zero is better than a small number invented to avoid one.

classes.name: Barca
classes.note: A coaster: turns on a sixpence, carries nothing that shoots, and sees as far as her one short mast allows.

classes.name: Caravela latina
classes.note: The lateen caravel — the handiest hull afloat, with two guns aboard because the coast is not always friendly.

classes.name: Nau / Carrack
classes.note: Four hundred tuns of ship: slow to answer the helm, hard to hurt, and she fights at a distance because she must.

_slots: How many fittings of each kind a hull may carry, by tier. DESIGN_V1 §1.5, and the owner: 'for tier 1, sail, weapon, anchor would do. and 3 captain slot. it will grow as the tier of the ship grows'. Slots are TYPED, so a tier-3 hull is not simply more of anything.
_unlocks: Slots a hull's LEVEL opens beyond her yard slots (docs/SHIPS_AND_GEAR.md §6.2) — public.class_slot_unlocks (0127). Read only by world.ship_slots, and only while levels_bite is on.
